message.reasoning_content:
The user wants a Python function fib(n) that returns the nth Fibonacci number, with only code and no explanation.

Let me think about what the best implementation would be. There are several options:
1. Recursive (naive) - exponential time, bad for large n
2. Iterative - O(n) time, simple
3. Memoized recursive - O(n) time but recursion depth issues
4. Matrix exponentiation - O(log n)
5. Fast doubling - O(log n)

Since the user just wants a simple function, an iterative approach is clean and efficient enough. But I could also do fast doubling for elegance
